label: D1 after a reward, when the agent is about to choose a2, in the early-to-mid episode (trials 3-39)
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded). Almost every activation (>99.9%) comes right before the agent picks a2, which is the agent's own upcoming choice (allowed; previous action is nearly always a2 too, so this is mostly rewarded-a2 with a2 about to be repeated). Activation is also tied to time in the episode: none on trials 0-2 or 50+, peaks at trials 10-29 and fades by trials 40-49. That looks like slow drift in the hidden state, not task structure. Model readouts at these steps sit in a narrow band (value 7.5-7.75, D1 choice logit -4.4 to -1.5, a mild a2 lean). Adding choice < -1.52 raises dev F1 to 0.85, but that uses model output, so I left it out. Does not fire at GO or D2, after no reward, or before a1 choices. Being rewarded on a common versus rare transition, and the hidden good state, add little (requiring good==2 or prev_common==1 drops recall). Magnitude is highest on runs of consecutive rewarded a2 trials; not checked further. Precision about 0.68: many qualifying steps stay silent, most likely because of the drifting hidden-state and value condition.
